sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Key observation: The right panel reset to ALL gray when I completed the cross pattern. This is a CRITICAL finding that disproves my hypothesis.
Also important: Look at the tool area. The blue/sky blue pieces on the bar have CHANGED. Previously there were two 2-pixel pieces (blue at 35 and sky blue at 36). Now there's only ONE 2-pixel sky blue piece at (19,36). The blue piece at (19,35) is gone!
Wait, let me re-read the segmentation:
- id=6: color=b, pixels=2, boundary=[[19, 35], [20, 35]] - blue piece still there
- id=7: color=S, pixels=2, boundary=[[19, 36], [20, 36]] - sky blue piece still there
Actually they're still there. But the right panel reset. So the game detected the completed pattern and reset the canvas.
This means the game IS checking for pattern completion. But the level didn't complete - it just reset the right panel. Maybe:
1. The pattern needs to be painted in a specific COLOR (not green) - maybe purple to match the left panel
2. The tool at the top needs to be configured to paint purple
3. The blue+sky blue pieces on the tool bar determine the paint color
Currently the paint color is green (N). The left panel shows purple (p) dots. Maybe I need to move the tool pieces to produce purple paint.
Let me think about the tool:
- There's a blue square on the left (id=2, pixels=14)
- Inside it is a sky blue square (id=3, pixels=16) - wait, that's bigger...
- On the bar: blue (2 pixels) and sky blue (2 pixels)
Maybe the bar position determines the color. Different positions on the bar = different colors. I need to find the position that produces purple.
Let me try moving the tool RIGHT to see if the color changes.
